artworks.title: Disparate de Carnabal (Carnival Folly)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in elaborate costumes. The figures have exaggerated expressions on their faces and some are leaning forward. The background consists of abstract shapes, rocks, or other indistinct forms. The composition includes dynamic lines and shading for contrast and depth.

artworks.title: Los ensacados (The Men in Sacks)
artworks.description: This is a painting of ghostly figures standing in a line. The image depicts a group of indistinct, cloaked figures with haunting appearances. They are shown in varying poses and heights, creating a sense of movement within the scene. The figures are set against a dark background. The use of shadow and light, with an emphasis on chiaroscuro, contributes to the atmosphere of the artwork.

artworks.title: Landscape with View of a Farmer's Cottage and a Town near a River
artworks.medium: etching//conjoining landscapes on 2 sheets of paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral landscape divided into two sections. On the left, a bridge leads to a medieval village with domed towers and an arched stone entrance. The village appears bustling and developed, extending into the distance where mountains can be seen with a structure on top. On the right, there is a dense collection of trees and a simple cabin, creating a contrast to the village scene. The trees and cabin suggest a quieter, forested environment. The artwork features delicate and detailed brushstrokes and etching techniques, creating texture, especially on natural elements like trees and rocks. The color palette is monochrome, with black lines on a beige background, emphasizing the intricate line work and shading. The composition guides the viewer's eye from one section to the other, creating a sense of depth and contrast within the frame.

artworks.title: Jan Cornelisz Sylvius, the Preacher
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: In this sketch, a person is portrayed as an upper body illustration, seated and leaning slightly forward. The person appears to be of older age, with a prominent nose and long hair that flows down past their shoulders. The person is wearing a loose, flowing garment, perhaps a robe or cloak. They are situated in front of an easel or stand and seem to be holding a brush or some implement in their hand, poised as if in the act of creating or writing. The background is plain and unadorned, focusing attention on the subject and their activities, with no additional objects or details visible in the environment.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.7 x 11.8 cm (6 9/16 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. A central figure is depicted rising from a rectangular structure, surrounded by other figures laying or sitting around. The central figure stands with a halo above their head, draped in cloth and holding a staff with a cross and banner. Various elements like plants, rocks, shields, and a helmet are included. The drawing features detailed linework and shading characteristic of classic religious iconography engravings.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with various figures and animals in a rustic setting. It is a complex etching with intricate details, featuring wooden structures, a stable, a cow near stone walls, and several figures. The image shows a variety of textures, from thatched roofing to tree bark, creating a rich tapestry of lines and shading. Above the scene, there is a figure flying among clouds with light streaming down. The overall atmosphere blends divine intervention with everyday rustic life, typical of scenes that blend the earthly with the heavenly. The style of crosshatching and expressive linework gives it a classical and dramatic feel.

artworks.title: A Canon Table with a Lamentation (formerly known as the "Traveling Altar")
artworks.medium: woodcut printed on parchment in black with hand coloring; set between two panels of printed text to form a triptych; housed in a slipcase with an embroidered crucifixion scene on the front and backed in leather; in turn housed in a velvet, silk, and linen box, strengthened with layers of paper from an account book, with ornamental tassels at each corner

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: The image displays five individuals. In the center, a woman is seated, holding a small child on her lap. To the left, two standing figures hold ornate containers. To the right, a bearded man stands, while another figure kneels. All figures wear robes. In the background, there are three animals, architectural elements, and a walled city in the distance, along with foliage.

artworks.title: Les Voeux acceptees
artworks.description: This image shows elegantly dressed figures in an outdoor garden setting. The scene includes figures moving gracefully surrounded by lush greenery and trees. The figures wear flowing, ornate historical garments within a circular frame. The frame is accentuated by a decorative motif of leaves and flowers, creating a refined and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Pastoral
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Rabbi Hugo B. Schiff
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals sitting on the ground. One is playing a flute while the other appears to be listening. The boy has short, curly hair and wears a long-sleeved shirt and pants. The girl has straight, dark hair and wears a short-sleeved blouse under a dark pinafore or jumper. Beside them is a wooden fence post and a calf, as well as grazing pigs in the foreground. A goat stands beside the girl. The background shows trees and open space, creating a rural atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Tern Schooner "Minnie G. Loud"
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a large schooner named "Minnie C. Loud," dominating the scene from left to right. The ship is depicted in profile, with three tall masts and fully unfurled sails. The horizon is low, and there are gentle waves in the water. The ocean is depicted in vibrant shades of blue, contrasting with the light sky above painted with fluffy clouds. In the distance, two smaller sailing ships appear on either side of the schooner.

artworks.title: Claude Dupouch
artworks.medium: pastel on blue laid paper mounted on canvas (on stretcher/strainer)
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a red, ornately patterned chair. He leans slightly forward with his arms resting on the back of the chair. His head is turned slightly to the left, facing the viewer. The man has a round face with warm complexion and gentle features. He has dark eyes and is bald, with some hair above his ears. He wears a black cap and a black coat with a white ruffled shirt visible at the cuffs. A bright blue fabric is also visible. In the background, there is a brown-toned backdrop contrasting with a sky-blue panel on the right. An easel is partially visible.

artworks.title: The Copley Family
artworks.artist: Robert Thew after John Singleton Copley
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Copley Amory, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a family portrait with a composition that includes the full bodies of five individuals. There are two adults seated and two children positioned around them. One adult is sitting in a chair on the left, with one child on their lap, while another adult on the right is holding another child. The adults have distinct features, with wigs styled in a manner suggestive of 18th-century fashion. The gentleman has a dark coat and knee-high stockings, and the lady wears an elaborate dress with voluminous sleeves and fabric, adorned with a bow. The children are clad in light-colored clothing typical of the era, and a small child stands in front, facing forward. The background features an ornate setting with a large column and a richly upholstered armchair, all set against a backdrop of foliage and a distant landscape view.

artworks.title: Wildflowers
artworks.medium: pastel on brown wove paper coated with sawdust
artworks.description: A bouquet of coral orange, bright yellow, and periwinkle blue flowers and greenery are arranged in a teal-green vase in this pastel drawn on brown paper. The orange flowers have long, curved petals. The yellow flowers have wide blooms with spiky petals, and the blue blossoms are smaller with wispy petals. The vase has a narrow opening and wide shoulders. The background is mostly the tan of the paper with some light-handed, black shading to the right. The artist signed the drawing in the lower right corner, “Odile Redon.”

artworks.title: Pansies
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection, Gift of the Adele R. Levy Fund, Inc.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion [verso]
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval-style illustration with three figures. In the center, a bearded figure with eyes closed, wearing a crown of thorns and a cloth around the waist, is on a cross with outstretched arms. On the left, a person in a robe with a halo holds a book. On the right, another figure in a robe and halo with a hat holds an open book. The illustration features a red and beige color scheme, intricate scrollwork, and decorative foliage patterns, with a parchment-like background.

artworks.title: The Marriage; the Kiss of the Bride (initial P); the Bride Abandoned (initial D)
artworks.description: This is a page from a book, with two tall columns of black text following a rectangular scene at the upper left corner, which shows a crowd under a balcony. Painted on vellum, the page also has a deocrated capital P and D, and a few other markings in cobalt blue and scarlet red. All the people in the scenes have pale skin. Most of the women wear crowns over long, braided hair. Their long dresses and the men's tunics and robes are painted in shades of azure or sky blue, crimson red, or pine green. In the rectangular illustration at the top left, a crowd of more than a dozen people gather closely around a man wearing a scarlet-red tunic, hood, and stockings, putting a gold ring on the hand of a woman wearing a shell-pink dress and a translucent veil under her crown. Two men to our right blow long horns, a man in front of them bends over to strike a pair of drums, and a woman to our left plays an instrument like a violin. Five people peek over the edge of a balcony above the crowd in front of a shining gold background. Below this scene, the man and woman are shown from the waist up within the round form of the captial letter P. They kiss and embrace against a vibrant blue background. In the D below, which resembles an O with an elongated apostrophe at the top, a woman with brown hair, wearing a garment that is half red and half green, holds a hand to her chest, her lips parted. The other hand rests on the bottom of the opening within the D. The tightly spaced text, next to the P and D, extends down to the bottom of the column and the right column is entirely text. About halfway down the right column, a smaller capital P is picked out with blue against a red field, and marks in blue and red are interspersed in the text in that column. There is a wide margin surrounding the text around all four sides of the sheet. The Roman numeral four, written as "IIII" alternating between red and blue strokes, appears at the top center.

artworks.title: Allegory of Vanity (Death Surprising a Woman)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 35.9 x 25.2 cm (14 1/8 x 9 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude person admiring their reflection in a large mirror. Their body is twisted as they reach up to touch their head, which is covered with a cloth. They have classical facial features with prominent eyebrows and a defined jawline. In the background, there is a skeletal figure holding an hourglass and a wheel, symbolizing the passage of time. Beside the person are a pair of wings, and in the corner, a column with a garland. The background shows an intricately detailed interior wall with a Latin phrase at the bottom and the artist's monogram in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: White Eagle and Crown of Poland
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines, shapes, and patterns. A large crown-like shape is at the top with eye-like elements below it. Curving lines, leaf-like forms, and floral motifs are present throughout, resembling blooming flowers. Vase-like and urn-like forms cradle bouquets in the lower section, surrounded by a border of small floral designs.

artworks.title: Christian with the Shield of Faith, Taking Leave of His Companions
artworks.medium: graphite, pen and ink, and watercolor
artworks.description: This is a painting of four ethereal figures walking together with a faint architectural background. The figures are posed gracefully, with flowing garments. The artist uses soft hues of pink, blue, and yellow. In the background, an outline of a grand structure emerges. The delicate application of color and line work creates an otherworldly atmosphere.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page. The central space is filled with elegant script, flanked by two seated figures resembling mythical creatures with human and animal features. These figures are integrated into a decorative frame with scroll-like patterns and elaborate structures. At the top, a figure with flowing hair is overlooked by two symmetrical candlesticks. The text in the center includes the title "BIZARIE di varie Figure di Giovanbattista Braccelli pittore fiorentino All'Ill.mo s. Don Pietro Medici 1624," suggesting it is a work by Giovanni Battista Braccelli dedicated to Don Pietro Medici, dated 1624. The drawing exhibits a baroque style focusing on intricate detailing and symmetry.

artworks.title: Dedication to Don Pietro Medici from "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic shield with decorative elements. The design features a shield in the center displaying six roundels, arranged in two groups of three. The shield is framed by a border that includes floral and scroll motifs. Above the shield are two cherubic figures interacting with the shield's top edge. On either side of the shield are weapons, flags, and a drum styled in an ornate manner. The inscription "S.DON PIETROMEDICI" appears below the shield. The image is detailed with lines and cross-hatching.
